physics-killer-04.title: Bhora rakakandwa nenzira yakachinjika
physics-killer-04.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-04.material: Bhora rakakandwa nenzira yakachinjika kubva pamupendero wegomo ine kukwirira $20\,\mathrm{m}$, uye rakawira pasi panzvimbo ine chinhambwe chakachinjika $30\,\mathrm{m}$ kubva pagomo. Kana $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ uye kuramba kwemhepo kusingatariswe, ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama wekumhanya kwebhora panguva rinorovera pasi nezvakawanikwa $\theta$ kona $\tan\theta$ yokumhanya pamwe neplane yakachinjika zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.prompt: Bhora rakakandwa nenzira yakachinjika kubva pamupendero wegomo ine kukwirira $20\,\mathrm{m}$, uye rakawira pasi panzvimbo ine chinhambwe chakachinjika $30\,\mathrm{m}$ kubva pagomo. Kana $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ uye kuramba kwemhepo kusingatariswe, ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama wekumhanya kwebhora panguva rinorovera pasi nezvakawanikwa $\theta$ kona $\tan\theta$ yokumhanya pamwe neplane yakachinjika zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.explain: Mukati wakatwasuka $20=\frac12\cdot10\cdot t^2\Rightarrow t=2\,\mathrm{s}$. Wakachinjika $30=v_0t\Rightarrow v_0=15\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Pakarepo risati rarova $v_y=gt=20\,\mathrm{m/s}$. $v=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=25\,\mathrm{m/s}$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{v_y}{v_0}=\dfrac{20}{15}=\dfrac43$. Kuwedzera kumhanya se $v_0+gt=35$ ndiyo nhema ①, kupidigura $\tan\theta$ kunopa $\frac34$ (nhema ②), kushandisa chikamu chakatwasuka $20\,\mathrm{m/s}$ chete sokumhanya ndiyo nhema ④.
